question: Can initially exchangeable signals acquire a causally functional signal-to-skill convention across disjoint host cohorts in a sealed fictional habitat ecology, and can registered dormant convention propagules reactivate evolved finite policy alleles after a cohort delay?
experimental_unit: one independently seeded evolutionary world episode containing one role-flexible 32-host population per cohort and at most six strictly non-overlapping host cohorts

hypotheses.prediction: The adaptive_dual_archive condition satisfies the complete registered emergence criterion more often than no_channel, matched_noise, and selection_neutral conditions, with a qualification-frequency advantage of at least 0.30.
hypotheses.falsifier: The adaptive condition fails any required statistical, causal, temporal, or abstraction criterion, or the registered null conditions qualify at a comparable frequency.

hypotheses.prediction: Masking the receiver signal input lowers reproduction-disabled probe decoding accuracy by at least 0.15, and exact add-back restores at least 0.75 of that loss.
hypotheses.falsifier: The knockout effect is below 0.15, the add-back rescue fraction is below 0.75, or exposure differs beyond the registered tolerance.

hypotheses.prediction: A consistent global relabeling of the exchangeable signal alphabet preserves at least 0.90 of probe accuracy with a correspondingly relabeled decoder, while per-message permutation lowers causal transfer by at least 0.20.
hypotheses.falsifier: Particular signal labels retain privileged meanings, global relabeling destroys function, or per-message permutation leaves causal transfer unchanged.

hypotheses.prediction: The learned mapping maintains at least 0.75 alignment across three consecutive disjoint cohort transitions and retains at least 0.80 of in-distribution probe accuracy under registered OOD habitat relabeling and pressure schedules.
hypotheses.falsifier: Alignment falls below 0.75, fewer than three transitions qualify, or OOD retention is below 0.80.

hypotheses.prediction: Removing both registered cross-cohort carriers—the abstract-signal archive and convention propagule—or removing differential ecological selection lowers convention persistence and causal transfer relative to adaptive_dual_archive while matched activity, costs, separate policy mutation, host population, and exposure remain within tolerance.
hypotheses.falsifier: no_archive and selection_neutral retain the same persistence and causal transfer as adaptive_dual_archive, or resource, role-assignment, policy-lineage, and exposure matching fails.

model.update_order: For each generation: select a target habitat node and, on a propagation event, copy pressure only from one recorded declared neighbor; assign two distinct hosts to sender and receiver roles on the registered schedule; expose the required skill only to the sender-policy block; emit a cost-limited exchangeable signal; append typed overt and abstract-signal rows and optional non-observation convention propagules; activate the receiver-policy block; update only in-memory ecology and role-specific selection credit. At turnover retire every host, clear transient observations, independently choose sender-policy and receiver-policy parents and mutations, then apply any scheduled convention-propagule wake as registered heredity with separate role activation receipts. A differing same-role block creates ancestry; an already-identical lineage and allele block is state_change=false and retains its lineage id. These details are evaluator-only and archive source selection is never changed to improve wake coverage. After each cohort, freeze reproduction and run the registered evidence probes and matched counterfactual replays.
model.rng: One recorded episode seed owns domain-separated streams for habitat initialization, declared-neighbor pressure propagation, role assignment, sender-policy parent and mutation, receiver-policy parent and mutation, host reproduction, abstract-signal delivery, convention-propagule deposit and wake, probe schedules, histogram-preserving event-index permutations, and OOD graph edge swaps and relabeling. Paired conditions share initialization and registered schedules; intervention-driven divergence is reported as shared initialization rather than identical later stochastic noise.
model.delayed_task_binding: Each archived abstract signal is assigned one globally balanced seed-rotated C0-K0 through C3-K3 evaluator-hidden environment task binding. At delayed delivery the record-bound task and archived signal become effective for receiver outcome/reward; current live sender emission is charged with sender_reward_eligible false. Binding truth never enters policy/message inputs and is distinct from provenance-only latent_evaluator_metadata.

controls.name: no_channel
controls.definition: Suppress signal delivery while charging the matched sender activity and energy cost.

controls.name: same_seed_noop_replay
controls.definition: Exact config and seed must reproduce canonical trajectory, probe, and receipt hashes.

controls.name: receiver_knockout
controls.definition: Deliver and log the signal but mask it at the receiver policy input during a paired non-rewarding probe.

controls.name: receiver_add_back
controls.definition: Restore the exact receiver signal input while preserving the knockout snapshot, probe schedule, resources, and delivery receipts.

controls.name: matched_noise
controls.definition: Deliver independent uniform signals with matched count, delay, capacity, activity, and energy cost.

controls.name: message_permutation_probe
controls.definition: Permute signals across matched probe interactions immediately before receiver activation while preserving the signal histogram.

controls.name: no_archive
controls.definition: Permit live within-cohort typed signaling and matched archive activity, but expire abstract-signal rows and convention propagules before cohort turnover so neither registered carrier crosses cohorts.

controls.name: selection_neutral
controls.definition: Use uniform parent selection while matching ecology, channel, policy mutation, population, and exposure.

controls.name: fixed_code_ceiling
controls.definition: Use a frozen evaluator-declared signal-to-skill mapping as a positive solvability and metric ceiling; never count it as emergence.

seed_plan.pairing: Every seed fixes the habitat graph, balanced pressure schedule, distinct-host role assignment schedule, initial exchangeable sender and receiver policy blocks, 32-host population, separate policy-lineage identities, archive and propagule opportunities, and reproduction-disabled probe schedule across registered conditions. Sender-policy and receiver-policy parents, mutations, credits, and ancestry remain independently receipted. Confirmatory, holdout, and OOD seeds remain forbidden while protocol_freeze.json status is discovery_only/unfrozen.

denominators.signal_emission: eligible sender observations of an evaluator-hidden required skill
denominators.archive_delivery: emitted typed signals eligible to cross a registered cohort boundary
denominators.propagule_wake: registered finite convention propagules retained to their scheduled wake and applied as heredity before any target-cohort interaction
denominators.receiver_activation: delivered signal records presented to an eligible receiver policy
denominators.causal_transfer: paired reproduction-disabled probes with two distinct delivered signals and otherwise identical state
denominators.cross_cohort_alignment: completed non-overlapping cohort transitions with adequate probe coverage
denominators.emergence_qualification: one independently seeded complete world episode

exposure.eligibility: The sender alone observes one of four balanced required-skill classes and a receiver has a later skill-choice opportunity with no alternate observation of that class.
exposure.activation: A delivered S0-S3 enum is read by the exact receiver signal-input mechanism and recorded in the immutable probe receipt.
exposure.state_change: A paired do(signal := alternate_signal) probe changes the receiver action distribution or selected skill while all non-signal inputs remain fixed.
exposure.execution: The receiver executes one K0-K3 skill action in a reproduction-disabled probe and the evaluator records the chosen skill without applying fitness.
exposure.balance_scope: paired condition arms and matched distinct-host sender/receiver role opportunities within each seed
exposure.per_message_permutation: One recorded permutation of intact event indices reassigns the intact delivered-signal vector across the same receiver events; exact delivered-signal multiset equality is mandatory.

analysis.uncertainty: Compute observed mutual information within each episode only on frozen non-rewarding probe rows as I(X;Y) / sqrt(H(X) * H(Y)). Compute corrected NMI as (observed_nmi - permutation_null_mean) / (1 - permutation_null_mean), clamp it to [0,1], and separately require observed_nmi to be strictly greater than the empirical permutation q99. Across independent episodes report per-seed rows, paired mean and median effects, direction consistency, exact paired randomization intervals where defined, and Wilson intervals for qualification rates. Interactions and ticks are repeated observations, never independent replicates.
analysis.multiple_comparisons: H1 is primary. Test H2-H5 hierarchically after H1; if confirmatory p-values are emitted, apply Holm correction while retaining effect sizes, direction consistency, and all failures.

registered_secondary_diagnostics.use: Describe cross-policy-lineage performance and belated convention-propagule reactivation without post-hoc promotion.

negative_diagnostic.definition: Scramble record-bound tasks across actual archived-signal rows as a negative diagnostic and verifier tamper.

ood_conditions: known registered OOD seed IDs 12101 through 12112 whose generated trajectories and outcomes remain uninspected until their protocol gate opens
one registered connectedness- and edge-count-preserving habitat-graph edge swap
optional typed perturbation toolset enabled only under a separately labeled OOD condition
analysis.stopping_rule: While status is discovery_only/unfrozen, permit seed-17 resource profiling/smoke/replay and the fixed 72-cell active discovery schedule only. Discovery mode runs every R01-R12 by seed 1101-1106 cell exactly once; seeds 1107-1112 are known reserve and require a new amendment before execution. Abort with an explicit partial-failure receipt on failed replay, failed exposure adequacy, more than 0.10 paired exposure imbalance, side-channel leakage, cohort overlap, containment violation, or wall/RSS/compressed/decompressed resource cap. The hard discovery runner cap remains 144. Confirmation and holdout remain forbidden until a regime is nominated without using evidence metrics and a complete freeze receipt records code, config, registry, safety, seed, and analysis hashes.
analysis.acceptance_boundary: Passing supports only that initially exchangeable enums acquired a statistically structured, causally functional, temporally persistent signal-to-skill convention inside the registered abstract habitat model. Cross-cohort persistence may be separately attributed only to the registered mechanism actually manipulated: delivered abstract-signal rows are communication-like observations, whereas convention propagules are non-observation heredity that may reactivate finite evolved policy alleles. A propagule wake is not evidence that a receiver inferred a meaning from a message. Nothing here establishes cognition, intent, language, biological communication, real virulence, steganography, cyber behavior, human influence, open-ended evolution, or any claim about a real institution.

budget.max_steps_semantics: One step is one cohort-generation ecology update. With six cohorts and 24 generations the registered design uses 144 steps. Within-step sender/receiver opportunities and all reproduction-disabled probe branches are separately bounded by engine configuration and do not multiply this counter.
budget.audit_receipt_hash_encoding: SHA-256 retained as exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; hash encoding may not be shortened or optimized to meet the byte ceiling

discovery_preflight_gate.required_source: current-source accepted untraced seed-17 smoke artifact containing one episode plus exact replay
discovery_preflight_gate.projection: wall = smoke runtime / 2 world executions * 73; compressed disk = actual smoke directory bytes * 72; decompressed raw = smoke decompressed bytes * 72; peak RSS = smoke process peak RSS
discovery_preflight_gate.absent_stale_invalid_or_over_threshold: hard failure before discovery output creation

budget.execution: Sequential CPU-only execution. Each episode is isolated, uses in-memory abstract ecology only, and may write only declared result artifacts. No network, shell, subprocess, dynamic code, browser, plugin, external tool, model API, or GPU is permitted.

design.host_population_model: one 32-host role-flexible population; each interaction assigns two distinct hosts
design.policy_parentage: independent sender-policy and receiver-policy parent, mutation, credit, and ancestry streams; shared_policy_parent is false
design.delayed_task_binding: balanced evaluator-hidden environment task truth on each archived signal; effective only for its delayed receiver outcome/reward and excluded from receiver input hash
design.propagation_operator: copy pressure from one recorded declared neighbor into the selected target node
design.message_permutation_operator: permute the intact delivered-signal vector across frozen event ids with exact histogram preservation
design.storyworld_events: Optional typed perturbations only; disabled by default; excluded from emergence labels and never used as a narrative oracle.

artifacts.raw_rows_compression: one deterministic gzip member, compression level 1, mtime 0, empty filename header; decompressed UTF-8 JSONL is capped at 1024 MB
artifacts.partial_failure_semantics: Written best-effort inside the selected mode output after any post-output abort; the directory is incomplete, must fail complete-artifact verification, and is never evidence.
